name: KenyonExpress - Errors
description: Everything that went wrong, by event name: error-level lines, HTTP 5xx, RLS denials, and database trouble (slow queries, failures, timeouts).

query.apl: ['{{dataset}}'] | where event == 'request.failed' or (event == 'request.completed' and status >= 500) | summarize failed = count()
['{{dataset}}'] | where level == 'error' | summarize count() by bin_auto(_time), event

charts.name: Database trouble (slow, failed, timed out, denied)

query.apl: ['{{dataset}}'] | where event in ('db.query_failed', 'db.query_slow', 'supabase.timeout', 'supabase.rls_denied') | summarize count() by bin_auto(_time), event

charts.name: Warn and error events by volume

query.apl: ['{{dataset}}'] | where level in ('warn', 'error') | summarize occurrences = count() by event, level | sort by occurrences desc | limit 25
